description: ChangesResponse.updated_properties (commit 52a3704) lists exactly which extensions populate it (RFC 8621 §2.2 Mailbox/changes, RFC 9425 §5 Quota/changes) and explicitly notes \"For all other /changes methods the field is absent on the wire and None here.\" This prevents the future-contributor question \"why is this field always None for my extension?\" by answering it inline. The associated test `changes_response_omits_updated_properties_when_none` proves the serialized wire output is byte-clean when the field is None. Defend against the (separately-filed) suggestion to move the field off the base type — if it stays on the base type, the doc-comment is the right way to keep it from becoming a foot-cannon.
title: updated_properties carries explicit doc-comment about extension-only semantics
